newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal sets new variable rate repo.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal sets new variable rate repo.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal offered to inject a further 30 billion escudos of seven-day funds into the money market in a variable rate securities repurchase tender.
The offer was in addition to the 280 billion escudos already offered when the Bank set conditions on Thursday for Monday's start of a new commercial bank reserve period.
The rate on the 280 billion escudo repo was 6.0019 percent.
Bids for the additional repo funds must be submitted by 0900 GMT.
